metrics.name: microsoftAds.impressions
metrics.label: Impressions
metrics.description: Number of times your ads were shown, including repeat views by the same person.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.clicks
metrics.label: Clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on your ads during the reporting period.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.ctr
metrics.label: CTR
metrics.description: Click-through rate: clicks divided by impressions, shown as a percentage.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.spend
metrics.label: Spend
metrics.description: Total advertising spend during the reporting period, in your account currency.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.avgCpc
metrics.label: Avg. CPC
metrics.description: Average cost per click: spend divided by clicks, in account currency.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.avgCpm
metrics.label: Avg. CPM
metrics.description: Average cost per 1,000 impressions: spend divided by impressions (×1,000), in account currency.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.avgPosition
metrics.label: Avg. position
metrics.description: Average position of your ad on the search results page during the reporting period.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.conversions
metrics.label: Conversions
metrics.description: Number of completed conversion actions you are measuring (e.g. purchases, sign-ups, leads).

metrics.name: microsoftAds.conversionRate
metrics.label: Conversion rate
metrics.description: Conversion rate as percentage: (Conversions / Clicks) × 100.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.costPerConversion
metrics.label: Cost per conversion
metrics.description: Average spend for each conversion: spend divided by the number of conversion events.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.viewThroughConversions
metrics.label: View-through conversions
metrics.description: Number of conversions from users who saw your ad but didn't click, then converted within the attribution window.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.viewThroughConversionsQualified
metrics.label: View-through conversions (qualified)
metrics.description: Qualified view-through conversions including partial values from external attribution.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.viewThroughRate
metrics.label: View-through rate
metrics.description: Percentage of impressions that resulted in a view-through conversion: view-through conversions ÷ impressions.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.viewThroughRevenue
metrics.label: View-through revenue
metrics.description: Revenue attributed to view-through conversions during the reporting period.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.conversionValue
metrics.label: Conversion Value
metrics.description: Total conversion value reported for attributed conversion events, in your account currency. Only populated when conversion tracking sends a value.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.revenueSpendRatio
metrics.label: ROAS
metrics.description: Return on ad spend: total revenue divided by total advertising spend.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.revenuePerConversion
metrics.label: Revenue per conversion
metrics.description: Average revenue per conversion: total conversion value ÷ conversions.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.assists
metrics.label: Assists
metrics.description: Number of times a click on your ad preceded a conversion that was ultimately attributed to a different ad.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.costPerAssist
metrics.label: Cost per assist
metrics.description: Average spend for each assist: spend divided by the number of assist events.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.revenuePerAssist
metrics.label: Revenue per assist
metrics.description: Average revenue per assist: total revenue ÷ assists.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.impressionSharePercent
metrics.label: Impression share
metrics.description: Percentage of available impressions your ads received: impressions ÷ total eligible impressions.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.impressionLostToBudgetPercent
metrics.label: Impression share lost (budget)
metrics.description: Percentage of eligible impressions your ads missed because your budget was too low.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.impressionLostToRankPercent
metrics.label: Impression share lost (rank)
metrics.description: Percentage of eligible impressions your ads missed due to poor ad rank.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.qualityScore
metrics.label: Quality Score
metrics.description: Measures how relevant your ad, keywords, and landing page are to users.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.expectedCtr
metrics.label: Expected CTR
metrics.description: Expected click-through rate component of quality score (1–3: Below Average, Average, Above Average).

metrics.name: microsoftAds.adRelevance
metrics.label: Ad relevance
metrics.description: Ad relevance score indicating how closely your ad matches user intent: 1=Below Average, 2=Average, 3=Above Average.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.landingPageExperience
metrics.label: Landing page experience
metrics.description: Landing page relevance score: 1=Below Average, 2=Average, 3=Above Average.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.lowQualityClicks
metrics.label: Low quality clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on your ads flagged as low quality (invalid or fraudulent).

metrics.name: microsoftAds.lowQualityClicksPercent
metrics.label: Low quality click rate
metrics.description: Percentage of total clicks flagged as low quality: low quality clicks ÷ total clicks.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.lowQualityImpressions
metrics.label: Low quality impressions
metrics.description: Number of impressions flagged as low quality.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.lowQualityImpressionsPercent
metrics.label: Low quality impression rate
metrics.description: Percentage of total impressions flagged as low quality: low quality impressions ÷ total impressions.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.phoneImpressions
metrics.label: Phone impressions
metrics.description: Number of times your phone number was displayed with your ad.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.phoneCalls
metrics.label: Phone calls
metrics.description: Number of calls made to the phone number displayed in your ad.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.ptr
metrics.label: Phone-through rate
metrics.description: Phone-through rate: percentage of phone impressions that resulted in a phone call.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.absoluteTopImpressionRatePercent
metrics.label: Abs. top impression rate
metrics.description: Percentage of your impressions that appeared in the absolute top position (above all search results).

metrics.name: microsoftAds.topImpressionRatePercent
metrics.label: Top impression rate
metrics.description: Percentage of your impressions that appeared in a top position above organic search results.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.absoluteTopImpressionSharePercent
metrics.label: Abs. top impression share
metrics.description: Percentage of total eligible impressions your ads received in the absolute top position.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.topImpressionSharePercent
metrics.label: Top impression share
metrics.description: Percentage of total eligible impressions your ads received in a top position above organic search results.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.clickSharePercent
metrics.label: Click share
metrics.description: Percentage of total eligible clicks your ads received: clicks ÷ total eligible clicks.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.exactMatchImpressionSharePercent
metrics.label: Exact match impression share
metrics.description: Percentage of eligible exact-match impressions your ads received for searches that exactly matched your keywords.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.conversionsQualified
metrics.label: Conversions (qualified)
metrics.description: Conversions including partial externally attributed offline conversions.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.allConversionsQualified
metrics.label: All conversions (qualified)
metrics.description: All conversions including partial values, regardless of ExcludeFromBidding setting.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.allConversionRate
metrics.label: All conversion rate
metrics.description: Percentage of clicks that resulted in any conversion (all types): all conversions ÷ clicks.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.allCostPerConversion
metrics.label: All cost per conversion
metrics.description: Average spend per all-type conversion: spend ÷ all conversions.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.allRevenue
metrics.label: All revenue
metrics.description: Total revenue attributed to all conversion types during the reporting period.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.allReturnOnAdSpend
metrics.label: All ROAS
metrics.description: Return on ad spend including all conversion types: all revenue ÷ spend.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.allRevenuePerConversion
metrics.label: All revenue per conversion
metrics.description: Average revenue per all-type conversion: all revenue ÷ all conversions.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.videoViews
metrics.label: Video views
metrics.description: Number of times your video ad was viewed.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.videoViewsAt25Percent
metrics.label: Video views 25%
metrics.description: Number of times your video ad was watched to at least 25% completion.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.videoViewsAt50Percent
metrics.label: Video views 50%
metrics.description: Number of times your video ad was watched to at least 50% completion.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.videoViewsAt75Percent
metrics.label: Video views 75%
metrics.description: Number of times your video ad was watched to at least 75% completion.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.completedVideoViews
metrics.label: Video completions
metrics.description: Number of times your video ad was watched to completion.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.videoCompletionRate
metrics.label: Video completion rate
metrics.description: Percentage of video views that were watched to completion: video completions ÷ video views.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.avgCpv
metrics.label: Avg. CPV
metrics.description: Average cost per video view: spend ÷ video views.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.avgWatchTimePerVideoView
metrics.label: Avg. watch time per view
metrics.description: Average time users spent watching your video ad per view.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.avgWatchTimePerImpression
metrics.label: Avg. watch time per impression
metrics.description: Average time users spent watching your video ad per impression.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.sales
metrics.label: Sales
metrics.description: Number of sales events attributed to your ads.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.costPerSale
metrics.label: Cost per sale
metrics.description: Average spend for each sale: spend divided by the number of sale events.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.revenuePerSale
metrics.label: Revenue per sale
metrics.description: Average revenue per sale event: total revenue ÷ sales.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.installs
metrics.label: Installs
metrics.description: Number of app installs attributed to the ad.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.costPerInstall
metrics.label: Cost per install
metrics.description: Average spend for each install: spend divided by the number of install events.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.revenuePerInstall
metrics.label: Revenue per install
metrics.description: Average revenue per install: total revenue ÷ installs.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.appInstalls
metrics.label: App installs
metrics.description: Number of app installs attributed to your ads.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.relativeCtr
metrics.label: Relative CTR
metrics.description: Your CTR compared to the average CTR of all other advertisers on the same websites: your CTR ÷ competitor average CTR.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.conversionRateByClicksPct
metrics.label: Conversion rate (by clicks)
metrics.description: Conversion rate (%) from clicks; same basis as API ConversionRate, as an explicit calculated measure. For session-based rates, join session data from another source—Microsoft Ads reports do not expose sessions. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.conversionRateByImpressionPct
metrics.label: Conversion rate (by impressions)
metrics.description: Percentage of impressions that resulted in a conversion: conversions ÷ impressions. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.allConversionRateByImpressionPct
metrics.label: All conversion rate (by impressions)
metrics.description: Percentage of impressions that resulted in any conversion (all types): all conversions ÷ impressions. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.revenuePerClick
metrics.label: Revenue per click
metrics.description: Average revenue per click: total conversion value ÷ clicks. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.revenuePerImpression
metrics.label: Revenue per impression
metrics.description: Average revenue per impression: total conversion value ÷ impressions. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.netConversionValue
metrics.label: Net conversion value
metrics.description: Profit from conversions after deducting ad spend: conversion value − spend. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.conversionValueMarginPct
metrics.label: Conversion value margin
metrics.description: Percentage of conversion value remaining after deducting ad spend: (conversion value − spend) ÷ conversion value. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.clickThroughRatio
metrics.label: Click-through ratio
metrics.description: Click-through ratio: clicks ÷ impressions, expressed as a decimal ratio. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.costPerMilleFromSpend
metrics.label: CPM (from spend)
metrics.description: Average cost per 1,000 impressions: spend ÷ impressions × 1,000. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.assistsPerConversion
metrics.label: Assists per conversion
metrics.description: Average number of assist clicks per recorded conversion: assists ÷ conversions. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.assistsPerClick
metrics.label: Assists per click
metrics.description: Average number of assist clicks per total click: assists ÷ clicks. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.viewThroughToClickConversionRatio
metrics.label: View-through to click conversion ratio
metrics.description: Ratio of view-through conversions to click-based conversions: view-through conversions ÷ conversions. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.allConversionsPerClick
metrics.label: All conversions per click
metrics.description: All conversions per click: all qualified conversions ÷ clicks. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.installRatePct
metrics.label: Install rate
metrics.description: Percentage of clicks that resulted in an install: installs ÷ clicks. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.appInstallRatePct
metrics.label: App install rate
metrics.description: Percentage of clicks that resulted in an app install: app installs ÷ clicks. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.salesRatePct
metrics.label: Sales rate
metrics.description: Percentage of clicks that resulted in a sale: sales ÷ clicks. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.videoViewsPerImpressionPct
metrics.label: Video view rate
metrics.description: Percentage of impressions that resulted in a video view: video views ÷ impressions. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.completedVideoViewsPerImpressionPct
metrics.label: Video completion rate (by impressions)
metrics.description: Percentage of impressions that resulted in a completed video view: video completions ÷ impressions. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.avgWatchTimeMsPerImpressionDerived
metrics.label: Avg. watch time per impression
metrics.description: Average total watch time in ms per impression (derived).

metrics.name: microsoftAds.lowQualityClickRatePct
metrics.label: Low quality click rate (calculated)
metrics.description: Percentage of total clicks flagged as low quality: low quality clicks ÷ total clicks. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

metrics.name: microsoftAds.phoneThroughRatePctDerived
metrics.label: Phone-through rate
metrics.description: Percentage of phone impressions that resulted in a phone call: phone calls ÷ phone impressions. Calculated in Jepto from other fields in this report using the formula on the metric.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.date
dimensions.label: Date
dimensions.description: Date of the reporting period.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.accountId
dimensions.label: Account ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the Microsoft Advertising account.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.accountName
dimensions.label: Account name
dimensions.description: Name of the Microsoft Advertising account.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.accountStatus
dimensions.label: Account status
dimensions.description: Current delivery status in the advertising platform (for example enabled, paused, or removed).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.campaignId
dimensions.label: Campaign ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the campaign.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.campaignName
dimensions.label: Campaign
dimensions.description: Name of the campaign. Shown in campaign reports and breakdowns.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.campaignStatus
dimensions.label: Campaign status
dimensions.description: Current delivery status in the advertising platform (for example enabled, paused, or removed).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.campaignType
dimensions.label: Campaign type
dimensions.description: Type of campaign (e.g. Search, Shopping, Audience, Dynamic Search Ads).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.adGroupId
dimensions.label: Ad group ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the ad group.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.adGroupName
dimensions.label: Ad group
dimensions.description: Name of the ad group. Shown in ad group reports and breakdowns.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.adGroupStatus
dimensions.label: Ad group status
dimensions.description: Current delivery status of the ad group (e.g. Active, Paused, Deleted).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.adId
dimensions.label: Ad ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the ad.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.adName
dimensions.label: Ad name
dimensions.description: Title or headline of the ad.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.adStatus
dimensions.label: Ad status
dimensions.description: Current delivery status in the advertising platform (for example enabled, paused, or removed).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.adType
dimensions.label: Ad type
dimensions.description: Type of ad (e.g. Expanded Text Ad, Responsive Search Ad, Dynamic Search Ad).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.adDistribution
dimensions.label: Ad distribution
dimensions.description: Where your ad was distributed (e.g. Search, Content, Mixed).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.deviceType
dimensions.label: Device type
dimensions.description: Type of device your ad was shown on (e.g. Computer, Smartphone, Tablet).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.deviceOs
dimensions.label: Device OS
dimensions.description: Operating system of the device your ad was shown on (e.g. Windows, iOS, Android).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.language
dimensions.label: Language
dimensions.description: Language of the user query or ad targeting at the time of impression.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.network
dimensions.label: Network
dimensions.description: Search network where your ad was shown (e.g. Bing Search, Bing Search Partners, Bing and AOL).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.topVsOther
dimensions.label: Top vs other
dimensions.description: Whether your ad appeared in a top position above organic results or in another position.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.bidMatchType
dimensions.label: Bid match type
dimensions.description: The match type you bid on for this keyword (Exact, Phrase, Broad).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.deliveredMatchType
dimensions.label: Delivered match type
dimensions.description: The actual match type that triggered your ad for a given search (Exact, Phrase, Broad).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.currencyCode
dimensions.label: Currency code
dimensions.description: Currency code for the account (e.g. USD, EUR, AUD).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.goal
dimensions.label: Goal
dimensions.description: Name of the conversion goal attributed to this result.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.goalType
dimensions.label: Goal type
dimensions.description: Type of conversion goal (e.g. URL, Duration, Pages Per Visit, Event, App Install).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.destinationUrl
dimensions.label: Destination URL
dimensions.description: The URL of the webpage where users land after clicking the ad.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.displayUrl
dimensions.label: Display URL
dimensions.description: The URL displayed in your ad creative.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.finalUrl
dimensions.label: Final URL
dimensions.description: The final landing page URL users were directed to after clicking your ad.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.adDescription
dimensions.label: Ad description
dimensions.description: The description text of your ad.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.adDescription2
dimensions.label: Ad description 2
dimensions.description: The second description line of your ad.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.titlePart1
dimensions.label: Title part 1
dimensions.description: First part of the ad title.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.titlePart2
dimensions.label: Title part 2
dimensions.description: Second part of the ad title.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.titlePart3
dimensions.label: Title part 3
dimensions.description: Third part of the ad title.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.headline
dimensions.label: Headline
dimensions.description: Headline text of your ad.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.longHeadline
dimensions.label: Long headline
dimensions.description: Long headline text used in multimedia or responsive ads.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.path1
dimensions.label: Path 1
dimensions.description: First display path appended to your URL in the ad.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.path2
dimensions.label: Path 2
dimensions.description: Second display path appended to your URL in the ad.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.businessName
dimensions.label: Business name
dimensions.description: Business name shown in your ad.

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.customerId
dimensions.label: Customer ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the Microsoft Advertising customer (manager account).

dimensions.name: microsoftAds.customerName
dimensions.label: Customer name
dimensions.description: Name of the Microsoft Advertising customer (manager account).
